decision_reason: The required pager endurance boundary was not available because task 14-04 produced no accepted selective+native-MTP run. The restored production service completed a bounded ordinary-service control soak and lifecycle restart, while focused local lifecycle coverage passed with one default-cache configuration failure and a deterministic f16 retry. No pager correctness, concurrency, leak, or prolonged max-context acceptance claim is made.

blocking_observations: 262144 and 131072 native-MTP contexts refused before listen because the full native-MTP context could not be reserved.
The reduced 32768 selective+native-MTP path reached startup but its first request failed during speculative suffix rollback.

phase_14_summary: Task 14-04 blocked the accepted speed prerequisite. Task 14-05 preserved that decision, exercised deterministic local lifecycle coverage, ran an ordinary-service request/cancellation/restart control soak, and restored qwen38-big with healthy 8080/8091 endpoints. A future run must repair and requalify selective native-MTP operation before the pager soak contract can be entered.
